name: Playable Guitar
teaser: A playable acoustic guitar that you can bring with you in your melee slot. Ever wanted to just chill for a moment and play the guitar? Well now you can!
description_html:
About
Playable Guitar is a custom melee weapon that I designed to play music instead of actually being a weapon. It features a few custom animations, guitar model, and around 12 songs at the moment. Most of the songs are from Stalker, and there’s a few other random songs I threw in that I liked. It has two actions you can perform: Left Click, which is a basic strum, and Right Click, which will start playing a random song. Additionally, you can also utilize the MIDI functionality to play custom songs, or play directly from a MIDI device.

How to obtain

You can get the Acoustic Guitar by purchasing it from Ragman, unlocked at Loyalty Level 2. It is currently not in any loot pools, nor is it sellable on the Flea market.

Adding MIDI Songs

First, download a .mid file that you want to add. Next, locate your BepInEx/plugins folder. Inside the plugins folder, open up the plugin called TarkovMIDI. In TarkovMIDI, drop the .mid file into the Midi-Songs folder.

Adding SoundFonts

First, download a .sf2 file that you want to add. Next, locate your BepInEx/plugins folder. Inside the plugins folder, open up the plugin called TarkovMIDI. In TarkovMIDI, drop the .sf2 file into the SoundFonts folder.

Recommended Mods


Hands Are Not Busy, by Lacyway - Since the guitar does not function like a conventional melee weapon, it is recommended that you install this mod in case of any busy hands problems that may occur. I did my best to make sure it doesn’t happen, but it still can in some cases, therefore I highly recommend you install this mod just in case.

Future Plans

- Fika Compatibility: Currently, in Fika, you can not hear songs being played by others, and the animations may not sync properly.

- Better and more animations: Sometime in the future, I want to redo all the animations and create the rest of the animations (inventory action, inspect, ect)
